Flairs are cosmetic abilities that provides no functional benefits to the hero. All flairs are available through the adventure hub and can be equipped from the cosmetics page of the inventory. There are four types of flairs available, healing flairs, level up flairs, respawn flairs, and mob flairs.

Healing flairs

Healing flairs are cosmetic effects that appear when a hero heals itself.

History

Minecraft Dungeons
October 16, 2021 Flairs are announced at Minecraft Live 2021.
November 12, 2021 In a twitter post, flairs were showcased by the hero, Hal, in the Cacti Canyon.[1]
November 27, 2021 A new level up flair is revealed in preview, the Bubbly flair.
December 6, 2021 In a twitter post, the firework level up flair was showcased by the Cloudwatcher atop the Obsidian Pinnacle.[2]
1.12.0.0 Added all flairs from Cloudy Climb.
1.14.1.0 Added all flairs from Luminous Night.
1.16.2.0 Added all flairs from Fauna Faire.
